title: introduce-dependency-ontology-and-lightweight-release-choreography
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: reduce friction and nondeterminism in release pipelines caused by heavy lockfile churn and opaque dependency provenance. This PR introduces a small, deterministic dependency ontology and a lightweight provenance collector that runs as an early pre-release job; it annotates release artifacts with a compact provenance bundle (sha, declared source, ontology category) and wires that bundle into the release signing step so downstream auditors can quickly answer 'where did this binary's deps come from' without regenerating the full lockfile. Key goals: 1) keep release pipeline fast and stable (avoid lockfile regeneration in CI), 2) provide a searchable, compact dependency provenance artifact for audits and incident triage, 3) classify deps into runtime/compile/test/infra so downstream cost/quantization tooling can better reason about what to optimize. Changes in this PR: - Add tooling/dep-provenance/collector.go and a tiny CLI `depprov` that parses go.mod/pipfiles and package.json, emits a compact JSONL provenance bundle and a canonicalized manifest used for deterministic signing. - Add tools/dep-ontology/ontology.yaml: human-maintained mapping of common transitive packages to categories with a fallback heuristic for unknown modules. - Modify .github/workflows/release.yml: introduce a new job `dep-provenance` that runs early in the release pipeline, uploads the bundle to the release artifact store, and ensures the release signing step consumes the bundle. - Update release_signer.py to validate provenance bundle checksum before signing and include provenance metadata in the signed manifest. - CI: add a lightweight smoke test step to the presubmit matrix that runs depprov against a tiny fixture to catch parsing regressions. - Docs: update docs/release/dep-provenance.md with usage and audit guidance. Checklist: - [x] depprov CLI implemented and unit-tested - [x] release.yml updated and tested in staging - [x] docs added - [x] reviewers addressed requested changes Risk/Notes: this change does not replace lockfiles or attempt to canonicalize every transitive source; it is intentionally conservative: for unknown modules we record VCS resolution strings or packaging metadata and mark them "unclassified" in the ontology. For customers requiring strict SBOM-style guarantees we recommend pairing this with existing lockfile artifacts. Related: ENG-1428 (dep provenance experiment), small follow-up PR planned to add npm/poetry caching hints.

release_notes: Add dep provenance collector and ontology; release pipeline now emits and signs a compact dependency provenance bundle for auditability; presubmit includes depprov smoke test; no behavioral changes to runtime artifacts.
files_summary: Small utility and CI wiring: collector CLI (Go), ontology YAML, release workflow changes, signer validation, docs and tests. No changes to runtime server code.
